نزدرد (form VIII)
# نَزْدَرِدُ (nazdaridu) /naz.da.ri.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# نُزْدَرَدُ (nuzdaradu) /nuz.da.ra.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# نَزْدَرِدَ (nazdarida) /naz.da.ri.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# نُزْدَرَدَ (nuzdarada) /nuz.da.ra.da/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
